title: Reasonable Towing Charge Counted in the Damages for Deductible Refunds
content:
Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), a tow part is added to the damages a refund is shared over, at the reasonable towing charge:
- when the tow and storage payments on the claim are more than the package's towing-from-scene limit, the tow part is that limit;
- when they are no more than that limit, it is the payments;
- when the claim carries no tow and storage payment, it is nothing.

| Package | Towing-from-scene limit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,500 Deductible | 150 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 150 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible | 200 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 200 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 250 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible | 250 |

### Both sides of the limit (hypothetical, on a package with a 200 USD limit)

| Tow and storage payments on the claim | Tow part |
|---|---|
| 260.00 USD | 200.00 USD (the limit) |
| 200.00 USD | 200.00 USD (no more than the limit) |
| 145.00 USD | 145.00 USD |
| None | Nothing |
